title: Cedarline Financial Services — Internships and Remote Working
topic: iş dünyası / staj ve uzaktan çalışma

texts.label: A
texts.heading: Summer Internship Application Guide
texts.text:
A
Cedarline Financial Services offers a ten-week summer internship each year to undergraduate students entering their second or final year of study. Applicants must be enrolled in a relevant degree, such as economics, accounting or business studies, and hold the right to work in the country for the full ten weeks without requiring sponsorship.

B
To apply:
- Complete the online application form and upload a current CV by 28 February.
- Submit a 300-word statement explaining your interest in the placement.
- Applicants shortlisted after the written stage will be invited to a video interview during March.
- A final assessment day, including a group exercise, takes place in early April for remaining candidates.

C
Successful applicants are notified by the end of April and must confirm their place within ten working days. The internship begins on the first Monday of July and includes a salary of £2,100 per month, plus a travel allowance for those relocating temporarily. Places are limited to fifteen interns across all departments.

D
Each intern is paired with a mentor from their assigned department who meets with them weekly throughout the ten weeks. Interns complete a short performance review at the five-week mark and a final review before departure; strong performers may be invited to apply for the graduate programme the following year, though this is not guaranteed and depends on business need.

texts.label: B
texts.heading: Remote Working Policy
texts.text:
A
Employees who have completed their probationary period may apply to work remotely for up to three days per week, subject to line manager approval and the operational needs of their team. Staff in client-facing roles may be required to attend the office more frequently regardless of general policy.

B
Employees working remotely are expected to:
- Provide their own reliable internet connection of at least 10 Mbps.
- Use company-issued laptops and comply with all data security procedures.
- Be available on instant messaging during core hours.
- Claim reimbursement for approved home-office equipment, up to £150 per year, through the expenses system.

C
Core hours for all staff, whether remote or office-based, are 10 a.m. to 4 p.m., during which employees must be reachable by phone or video call. Remote working arrangements are reviewed every six months and may be withdrawn if performance or availability standards are not met. Requests to change remote working days must be submitted at least one week in advance.

D
Employees must designate a single working location for remote days and notify the HR team in advance if that location changes for more than two consecutive weeks, for insurance and tax purposes. Working from outside the country is not permitted without separate written approval from both HR and the relevant country office, and such approval is rarely granted for periods longer than four weeks.
